output.reason: The evidence states that the 2014 circular/directions on “Levy of Foreclosure Charges/Pre-payment Penalty on Floating Rate Term Loans” were withdrawn/repealed by the “Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025,” effective from 2026-01-01, and that as of 2026-11-23 it is no longer in force. It also states that the “Directions, 2025” themselves were withdrawn/repealed by the “Consolidation of Regulations - Withdrawal of circulars (2025)” effective from 2025-11-28, and therefore are also not in force on 2026-11-23.
